verses: A Ma῾alot Poem. Happy is everyone who fears the Lord; who walks in his ways.
For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
Thy wife shall be like a fruitful vine in the recesses of thy house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord.
The Lord shall bless thee out of Żiyyon: and thou shalt see the good of Yerushalayim all the days of thy life.
And thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Yisra᾽el.
